about_the_game:
Awakened from deep cryosleep, Elyse realizes the ship she is on suddenly went off course and is bound to crash into a planet. After escaping, she finds herself alone on an alien world. Towering over, the sole structure in sight is an abandoned space station. It will be up to you to uncover its secrets and to find a way off the planet. It's your last hope of surviving this alien world.

But, that is only where Elyse’s worries and bad luck begins.

Embark on a perilous journey. Code:Elyse is an atmospheric metroidvania, set in a horror-esque sci-fi world. Explore and uncover the hidden secrets within this labyrinth of corridors. It is up to you to unearth the events that took place prior to you arriving and piece together what could have possibly caused all this ruin. Overcome the trails that await you, including all the horrors lurking in the dark.

Survive:

Power up by acquiring new abilities as you explore an abandoned space station and its many secrets through a beautiful hand-drawn pixel 2D Metroidvania. Battle strange and powerful creatures, and acquire new abilities

Features:

  • A beautiful hand-drawn pixel 2D Metroidvania

  • Explore an unknown world

  • Acquire new abilities throughout your journey

  • Solve your way through light puzzles

  • Uncover a dark mystery

  • Encounter strange and powerful creatures

  • Focus on making every shot count

  • Inspired by 32-bit classics

  • OS *: Windows 8/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo and 2.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo and 3.0GHz or better
